description: This file defines an Angular component called SidebarComponent used for rendering a sidebar interface in a note-taking application. It handles note selection, addition, and search functionality, communicating with parent components via event emitters.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component providing a sidebar UI for note selection, addition, and search functionalities in a note application.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called after component initialization. Currently used for static display setup; external notes are intended to be loaded externally.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Emits an event when a note is selected, sending the note's ID.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Emits an event to signal adding a new note.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Emits the current search string when the search input changes.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the search string and triggers a search change event.
